description: This file is a header (.h) file defining interfaces for Realtek RTL826XB PHY driver functions, including function prototypes for reading and writing SDS registers, as well as inclusion guards and conditional includes based on the Linux environment.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specific SDS register in the RTL826XB PHY device.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specific SDS register in the RTL826XB PHY device.
